notes.content: IMPLEMENTED 2026-07-10 (all 840 portable pairs, not just N2-O2): wrote dev/gen_mixture.py + dev/regen_mixture_all.py. Fluid-name resolution by CAS number (mixture_binary_pairs.json uses REFPROP short names like CYCLOHEX, not canonical CoolProp names). Implemented all 3 real departure-function forms for real (Power/GergExponential/Gaussian, ported from CoolProp's ResidualHelmholtzGeneralizedExponential::add_{Power,GERG2008Gaussian,Gaussian} in Helmholtz.h), verified each against finite-difference self-consistency. Discovered the Npower/leading-power-block split in CoolProp's own departure functions is unnecessary to replicate since GergExponential/Gaussian both degenerate exactly to pure power when eta=beta=0 (true for 100% of the surveyed data) -- simplified codegen accordingly. Split binary_pairs.rs into a binary_pairs/ dir (5 generated data_N.rs chunks + hand-maintained mod.rs) to stay under the 1000-line file-size cap (840 pairs would have been 1738 lines in one file). Handled 6 refrigerant-blend pairs (R32/R134a etc) that use xi/zeta instead of betaT/gammaT via CoolProp's LemmonAirHFCReducingFunction::convert_to_GERG formula. 48 of 888 pairs skipped (component outside the 137 ported pure fluids, e.g. R1216, isooctane). Verified: tests/mixture_nitrogen_oxygen.rs (unchanged), new tests/mixture_departure_function.rs (R32-R125, a real F=1.0 departure function, part of R410A -- confirms departure contribution is non-negligible + physical sanity), new tests/all_binary_pairs_smoke.rs (all 840 pairs at a dilute supercritical state). No flash/VLE (matches original scaffold scope). Bead can be closed.

title: Port CoolProp mixtures (multi-fluid Helmholtz + departure)
